Group play

Make room for your group.

Bring friends or colleagues together around a shared game.

01

Tell us about your group.

Share the number of people, their experience, and whether the aim is a relaxed introduction or time to play together. A clear group brief helps the team discuss a suitable format.

02

Choose the kind of session.

Discuss court time, coaching, or social play with the team. The right format depends on your group and the arrangements available. Include any preferences that would help everyone feel comfortable taking part.

03

Confirm the plan.

Ask about timing, equipment, costs, and club requirements before making plans. Your session is confirmed directly with the team. Keep the group informed once the arrangements are agreed.
